entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-03-12
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Thoughts About Some Kind of Splash Screen Layer on Component Level of Blazor #65766
  • (dotnet install-scripts) aspnetcore v10.0.105 not available #65764
  • Perf improvement: fortunes, https, mvc #65762
  • OpenAPI: `Dictionary<string, string>` generates empty schema when record is `[JsonDerivedType]` in two polymorphic interfaces #65759
  • Kestrel HTTPS/TLS API does not provide a way to handle TLS handshake failures #65758
  • Cache component #65756
    .NET 11 Planning
  • OpenAPI does not produce example for XML root which is a collection #65755
  • Minimal API : Converting empty string to Nullable (ex: bool?) with [FromQuery] binding #65754
  • Does WindowsCertificateManager correctly report cancellation? #65751
  • The Entity Framework migrations failed in the 11.0 preview 3 project with error "Your startup project doesn't reference Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Design.“ #65750
  • InputFile doesn't gracefully handle circuit disconnection while file picker is in foreground #65747
    Backlog
  • Scaffolding is Broken in .NET 11 #65746

Closed

  • SignalR Core server KeepAliveInterval doesn't reset with messages #65336
  • IIS dotnet process shutdown with .NET 10 runtime installation #64808
    11.0-preview2
  • `dotnet dev-certs https --trust --verbose` produces no diagnostic output on Fedora 43 Linux #65760
  • JSON deserialization errors with response.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<List<T>> where JsonSerializer.Deserialize works fine #57626
    Backlog
  • Blazor wasm + static web app => does not work with full trim mode. #65749
  • Cannot read properties of null (reading 'parentElement') in Virtualize interop #65139
    11.0-preview2

Created

  • fix HTTP/2: Content-Length mismatch with trailers split across CONTINUATION frames #65765
    area-networking
  • Fix perf regression: remove ZstandardCompressionProvider from default compression providers #65763
    area-networking
  • [release/10.0] Fix shutdown hang with IIS #65761
    Servicing-approved, area-networking
  • Bump serialize-javascript and @rollup/plugin-terser #65757
    area-infrastructure, Type: Dependency Update :arrow_up_small:, javascript, dependencies, build-ops
  • Update Blazor templates to use TempData #65752
    area-blazor
  • Update CODEOWNERS for directory ownership changes #65748
    area-infrastructure

Merged

  • fix http/2 header payload padding parsing #65729
    feature-kestrel, area-networking, 11.0-preview3
  • Fix null reference error in Virtualize component #65207
    area-blazor, 11.0-preview3

Updated

  • Fix shutdown hang with IIS #65733
    feature-iis, area-networking
  • Virtualization supports variable-height items #64964
    area-blazor
  • [release/11.0-preview2] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #65743
    area-infrastructure, Type: Dependency Update :arrow_up_small:
  • Fix Virtualize scroll container detection with horizontal overflow #65744
    area-blazor, feature-blazor-virtualization, .NET 11 Planning
  • SupplyParameterFromTempData support for Blazor #65306
    area-blazor
